results.name: Cyberpunk Noodle Kiosk – Environment Prop
results.description:
This is a cyberpunk-style noodle kiosk, created as a midground environment asset intended to populate street-level scenes in futuristic cityscapes. While not modular or a hero prop, it's built to sit comfortably within busy, neon-lit environments as a walk-past or background interaction point.

The model was created in Maya, and textured using Substance Painter with a focus on efficiency — relying primarily on a trim sheet and one unique texture map for supporting props like stools, kitchen elements, and signage. As a result, the texture detail is intentionally kept broad and stylized. The total polycount is approximately 105K faces.

This piece was built organically, adding smaller components like menu boards, lanterns, and utensils along the way. I had a lot of fun working on it, especially as a big fan of cyberpunk visual design. I’m planning to integrate this kiosk into a full environment scene soon to explore its role in a more complete setting.

results.name: Scifi Kiosk
results.description:
A sci-fi kiosk for decorating sci-fi scenes. No user interface graphics are included, screen is blank.

Geometry:

* Quads and tris
* Not subdividable
* Smooth shading with custom edge split normal data
* Modelled to real-world scale, units: metres
* Object is composed of multiple watertight islands that are intersecting.

Texturing:

* 3 baked PBR textures, Color, normal, roughness.
* 2048x2048 resolution (2K)
* png format
* completely UV mapped with no overlap

Created in Blender. .blend file has textures packed (embedded in the file). A HDRI is included for preview.

Extra model files here: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1WHne2oINQ_enmc718_EbXiA9OrMT7PmF/view?usp=sharing
